task: closed-set cross-country crop classification with risk-constrained early stopping

input_contract.observation_quality: timestamp availability and prefix coverage only; no SCL, cloud mask, or parcel geometry is present

separation_rules: Use target final-test labels only for final reporting.
Use target calibration labels only to calibrate the pre-specified risk policy, never to fit the classifier or select classes/cutoffs/model variants.
Use source development data for source-model selection.
Do not claim cross-year robustness, parcel-level cloud quality, or zero-shot target transfer.
